description: A one-person handmade craft studio making stickers, magnets, bookmarks, cups, tote bags, stationery, drink coozies, and home decor. No physical storefront -- Kenzie sells directly to customers at local craft shows and markets across the tri-state area, alongside an active Instagram and Etsy shop. Brand voice is warm, personal, and genuinely enthusiastic: every product comes from one person's love of making things that make people smile.
sellsAt: Local craft shows and markets across the tri-state area

aboutCreator.content: Hi! Welcome to Kenzie Keelie Studio. What started as a way to stay creative and keep a busy, crafty brain occupied has turned into a small business Kenzie genuinely loves running. She makes a little bit of everything, from stickers and stationery to bookmarks, cups, and bags, and loves coming up with new ideas and designing things that make people smile. Every order, share, and bit of support means more than you know.
